name: What are the signs of damaged siding corners?

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of damaged siding corners?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs of damaged siding corners include visible cracks, splits, or holes in the material. You might also notice peeling paint, warping, or discoloration, which can indicate moisture penetration. Soft spots when pressed, or the presence of rot, suggest significant water damage. Loose or missing pieces of siding, gaps where corners meet, or signs of pest infestation (like small holes or sawdust) are also clear indicators that your siding corners may need attention.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs of damaged siding corners include cracks, splits, holes, peeling paint, warping, discoloration, soft spots, rot, or loose pieces.
